name: Mage.space
tagline: Mage.space provides fast Stable Diffusion image generation with minimal restrictions. It supports multiple model checkpoints, ControlNet, image-to-image, and inpainting. Its straightforward interface and quick generation speeds make it popular with digital artists who need rapid iteration without complex setup.
